# vendor/

Put the PySpin wheel you downloaded from Teledyne here, e.g.

    spinnaker_python-4.4.0.246-cp312-cp312-win_amd64.whl

(It ships inside a .zip on the Spinnaker download page; extract the `.whl`.)
Wheels in this folder are git-ignored because the download requires a
Teledyne account and the version must match your installed Spinnaker SDK.
